notes.title: TLS 0.78.2b Achievement Hotfix
notes.notes:
I don't usually do this, but I've pushed live a Steam-only update. This one fixes the only three achievements that I know to be bugged:

  Yarra's maxing achievement.
  Altina's joining achievement, if she joins later.
  Orilise's library count and achievement.

I had planned to wait and try to get 100% of bugfixes at once, but a TON of people are playing TLS right now, so I figured I might as well give a hotfix. ^-^ If any other achievements are bugged, just let me know and I'll get on them!

Meanwhile, I'm trying something else exciting: a Kickstarter for one of my side projects:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sierralee/dont-save-the-princess

This is a different sort of game than TLS, but it's another brick in the foundation of my career, so please consider following the project if you want to keep up with it!

notes.title: Update on the Final Battle
notes.notes:
I'm always updating supporters on Patreon, but I didn't want to leave everyone else following the game in the dark for so long, so I have made a Patreon post public:

https://www.patreon.com/posts/102654309

More information (and fanart!) at the link, but basically I think it would be fastest and best for the game overall if I did one bigger update instead of two smaller ones. Please look forward to it!

notes.title: TLS MIni-update: Chapter 3 fully illustrated!
notes.notes:
New update for supporters on Patreon or SubscribeStar! More info here:
https://the-last-sovereign.blogspot.com/2023/11/tls-mini-release.html



TLS 0.71.0

- Fixed bug in Sarai's quest that made her event appear earlier in the game.

- Fixed issues with the alternate method to access the new Mother quests.

- Additional upgrades to the VN-style backlog script.

- Limit breaker script added. The only effect should be that characters no longer max at level 99, or so I hope.

- Two new illustrated scenes: Yarra + Hilstara, Victory Orgy

- Everything is illustrated through Chapter 3, so the "limited art" message has been moved to after that point.


This is not a major content update or anything, but I decided some of the bugs in the current version were unacceptable. Plus various fixes... and most dramatically, every single scene is now illustrated through Chapter 3! That gets the game through the Third Arclentian War and marks a substantial portion of the game illustrated. ^-^

Public update in a week, but my main focus is on the next major content update.

notes.title: TLS 0.50.1 - Chapter 1 Art Update is live!
notes.notes:
It's finally here! After a year of work behind the scenes, I'm launching the illustrated version of The Last Sovereign! Every single scene accessible in Chapter 1 of the game has at least one illustration.

TLS 0.50.0
 - Grand art update: All scenes in Chapter 1 now have an illustrated image!
 - Total added: 28 scenes, 5 joke scenes (62 images total)

TLS 0.50.1
 - Fixes and improvements.
 - New CG: Aka/Hilstara
 - A large amount of credit goes to Lamsey and Decanter for helping with the many scripts involved.

If you want scene previews, you can find them on the store page or here:
https://the-last-sovereign.blogspot.com/2020/04/tls-0500-released-chapter-1-art-update.html

This has been a long time coming. ^-^
